evidence: Added the op-present warn-mismatch reconciliation branch to issue2291_measure_check17_provenance.py. Previously only fail-trunc was reconciled, so the 6 op-present:warn-mismatch rows were classified with no shipped-result assertion while the script printed "reconciliation: script classification agrees with the shipped check on every row" — an overclaim, which the project bans. Both tiers fold warn-mismatch into warn_bits (v4: _context_row_result_v4; v3/v2: the legacy branch), so the shipped verdict must be a WARN carrying the #1068 context-origin-prompt-mismatch token; the new branch asserts exactly that.
